title: Story premise ENT008: The Polite Bowling Ball
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (physical comedy). Hook: This ball refuses to be rude. Takeaway/theme: Sometimes the goal can be redefined without a collision.
description: A bowler needs to clear a lane, but their sentient ball refuses to bump into the pins. After failed pep talks, the ball offers each pin a tiny chair at the side, rolls peacefully to the end, and receives a handmade KINDNESS score instead of a strike.
